### Meaning
| infl. | class | meaning                   |
| ----- | ----- | ------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*  | earth, ground, soil, dirt |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
Physics symbol for "earthing" or "connected to earth" minus the vertical line on top of the horizontal line. Imagine a pictograph of the ground, a horizontal line, except it has more lines to show layers of the earth's crust.
#### Sound
- *a priori:* g=earthliness, o=largeness
